813-1567-2320.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn or an opponent's upkeep.
Lands you control tap for enough to cast Reset and Momentary Blink.
813-1567-2320.description:
Activate all your lands by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast your two spells.
Cast Reset by paying its mana cost, causing you to untap all lands you control.
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages and putting Momentary Blink into your graveyard as it resolves.
Scholar of the Ages triggers when it enters, returning Reset and Momentary Blink to your hand.
Repeat.

280-2645-2872-3430.easyPrerequisites: Clever Conjurer doesn't have summoning sickness.
280-2645-2872-3430.description:
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Golgari Rot Farm
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

687-4050-4613-8130-8131.description:
Cast Aven Eternal by paying its mana cost; it enters with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
When Aven Eternal enters, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter from each of the two creatures and a -0/-1 counter from the Army token.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Aven Eternal and the creature token, adding two mana.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three and returning Aven Eternal from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
687-4050-4613-8130-8131.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {2} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

3234-3293-3899-5414.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-3899-5414.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-3899-5414.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1003-1927-3558-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1003-1927-3558-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

2452-3249-5173-5256.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3308-3946-7705.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-3129-3334-4762.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Primal Vigor and Lae'zel.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

153-759-1247-5963-6549.easyPrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
153-759-1247-5963-6549.description:
Animate Grove of the Burnwillows using Jolrael
Activate Marvin using Grove of the Burnwillows' second ability by tapping it, adding {R} or {G} and causing each opponent to lose 1 life due to Tainted Remedy.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

2457-3129-4289-4742.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2034-5003-7294.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hellspur Posse Boss, adding {C}{C}.
When Hellspur Posse Boss dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Hellspur Posse Boss from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Hellspur Posse Boss enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

4017-4659-5086-5183-6441.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4017-4659-5086-5183-6441.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

3175-3605-4812-6797.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-2841-6156-6529.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bad River.
1479-2841-6156-6529.description:
Fetch a land using Bad River.
When the fetched land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

874-1170-1329-4359.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1329-4359.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard.
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1018-2792-3647.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1018-2792-3647.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Skullwinder and Great Whale
When Skullwinder and Great Whale enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
1018-2792-3647.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Great Whale.

3678-5414-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
3678-5414-6879.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing the earthbended land.
Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.

1495-3311-6822.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Triskelion triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelion.
Repeat.

6338-6712-6781.manaNeeded: {2}{W} if you don't control a commander
6338-6712-6781.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature that has haste and/or flash.
6338-6712-6781.description:
Cast Flawless Maneuver by paying {0} if you control a commander or {2}{W} otherwise, giving creatures you control indestructible until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Shaman by sacrificing an artifact, dealing 1 damage to each creature without flying.
Sonic's second ability triggers for each creature you control with haste or flash that was dealt damage, creating that many tapped Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

104-2086-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 3 life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

513-527-1879.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
513-527-1879.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

215-2397-6470.description:
Cast Iridescent Tiger by paying {4}{R}.
When Iridescent Tiger enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Iridescent Tiger from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

465-719-3742-4251-4885.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-719-3742-4251-4885.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2440-3263-3464-4183.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
2440-3263-3464-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Hyrax Tower Scout with haste.
When the token Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Hyrax Tower Scout trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Hyrax Tower Scout.
Repeat.

457-969-5159-5491.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Map, adding {U}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it and a Map token for each Mishra's Warform and/or Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-969-5159-5491.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

722-3153-3504.notablePrerequisites: Mercurial Pretender is a copy of Sphinx of the Second Sun.
722-3153-3504.description:
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, both copies of Sphinx of the Second Sun trigger, causing you to get two additional beginning phases after this phase.
Move to your first additional beginning phase.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape,  causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

565-974-1954.notablePrerequisites: There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
565-974-1954.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token, and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Cast Change of Heart with buyback by paying {3}{W}, targeting the Smaug token.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put the new Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Smaug dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Resolve Change of Heart from step 2, returning it to your hand.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{W}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature(s) you control using Change of Heart, to create infinite tokens of them using Orvar.

2202-2723.notablePrerequisites:
Blazing Sunsteel attached to Zalto.
You have a way to give Zalto indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Zalto.
2202-2723.description:
Give Zalto indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Zalto.
Blazing Sunsteel and Zalto trigger.
Resolve the Zalto trigger, causing you to venture into the dungeon.
Resolve the Blazing Sunsteel trigger, dealing that much damage to Zalto.
Repeat from step 3.

573-1479-3875.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1479-3875.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Tireless Provisioner, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-849-3705-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Squee dies, triggering Anax, creating a 1/1 Satyr creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Satyr, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.
